name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #ffffff offset to all interactive elements. This gives keyboard users a clear, high-contrast indicator without losing shape or blending into backgrounds. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on dense interfaces, but it beats the alternative: users missing focus or struggling to see where they are.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks colliding with adjacent elements in dense UIs, making it hard to distinguish focus. A 3px ring at 80% opacity on dark backgrounds still risks disappearing on light ones. Settle it with a 2px ring at 90% opacity—test it on both light and dark themes to confirm visibility and spacing.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 80% opacity still risks fading into light backgrounds—WCAG 2 requires 3:1 contrast for focus indicators, and transparency drops this below the threshold. Test a 2px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px inner #ffffff offset instead; it meets contrast on both themes and avoids collision while keeping the shape crisp.
